# AnimalWalkState

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/animal_agent.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/animal_agent.h) · Described in `data/animal_agents.json`

The procedural walk the gait player plays on the kinematic body (demonstrations).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `walk` | `GaitWalk` | The walk (or the spawn's gait) as a GaitWalk. |
| `run` | `GaitWalk` | The run of ranges that run, when the animal has one. |
| `has_run` | `bool` | run is set up. |
| `running` | `bool` | This recorded walk is a run from end to end. |
| `blended` | `std::vector<glm::mat4>` | Pose blended toward standing as a command halts. |
| `plane` | `std::shared_ptr<GroundField>` | A PlaneField when the world has no ground field. |
| `ready` | `bool` | The walk can be played. |
| `problem` | `std::string` | Why not (no animal, not kinematic, no such clip, unreadable clip). |
| `bind` | `AnimalBodyBind` | The body bound to the species' skeleton. |

## Notes

Created by AnimalGaitPlayer in init; read by AnimalChecks, by TrainHost::animalDemoProblem and by the AA tests.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: AnimalChecks, TrainHost. Written by: AnimalGaitPlayer. Created by: AnimalGaitPlayer. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AnimalChecks](../systems/AnimalChecks.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | Which gait plays and its planted feet. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalChecks](../systems/AnimalChecks.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[AnimalGaitPlayer](../systems/AnimalGaitPlayer.md)**
  - Reads the species' files from the animal library in init.
  - Moves the ragdoll's kinematic Jolt bodies every tick.
  - Logs an error when the walk cannot be played.
- **[TrainHost](../systems/service-TrainHost.md)**
  - gRPC client of the ML-Agents trainer (MlAgentsClient on localhost:<port>); reads the environment parameters and engine configuration side channels.
  - Files: envparams.txt (-envParamsOut, written on change), .demo (record-demo), eval summaries (var.out), replays (<prefix>.track.*, .replay.*, .sandbox.*, .grass.bin), legs CSV, cot_out, demo checks JSON.
  - tf::Executor workers for bench, eval and the worlds' steps.
  - Restarts the worlds with the trainer's seed (ScenarioRunner::restart) when the trainer connects in mode=train.
  - Logs the mode's progress and summaries; exit codes 0 (QUIT, stop signal), 1 (bad arguments), 2 (connection lost).
